_comment: DESIGNED BUT NOT EXECUTED (see README, Phase 5). This policy was scoped out as part of a planned IAM privilege-escalation simulation: a low-privilege 'leaked credential' identity with just enough permission (iam:PassRole + ec2:RunInstances) to attach an over-permissive role to a new EC2 instance and harvest its temporary credentials via the Instance Metadata Service. Documented here as the intended design, not as evidence of an executed attack.
